cases.title: A hurtling cockatrice collides with an unarmored torso
cases.sourceTrace: C wizard telekinesis moves a peaceful cockatrice into a human Healer with no shirt, body armor or cloak. Collision message at step66 matches. After the actual collision More acknowledgment, C instapetrify displays You turn to stone at step67; JS instead records note_unported for the existing callee. Starting Healer gloves are irrelevant to this torso predicate. No later death prompt is claimed.
